title: qc.json
description: One dataset's row of the fleet QC table, written beside the store by scripts/bil-scripts/qc_store.sbatch (collect_dataset_stats.py --json). A value the run could not determine is null. The per-level columns n_<level> and mean_boot_<level> follow mmc_levels, which varies with the MapMyCells taxonomy: iterate over mmc_levels, never hard-code the levels. Producers may add columns; readers ignore what they do not know.

n_genes.description: Genes of the counts matrix — may include blank and control probes, unlike stats.json genes.

mask_percentile.description: 0 when no artifact mask was applied.

scraped_at.description: Local time of the QC run, ISO 8601 without zone.

mmc_levels.description: Comma-separated taxonomy levels, in no fixed order.
